description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableLogicalFilter class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package. It verifies immutability, equality, and string representations of filter logic, as well as null handling for filter creation.

classes.name: ImmutableLogicalFilterTest
classes.description: Test class for ImmutableLogicalFilter ensuring correctness of behavior, especially immutability, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableLogicalFilter instances are immutable and that related SearchFilter classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations for ImmutableLogicalFilter.

methods.name: tryToCreateNotFilterWithNullFilter
methods.description: Ensures that creating a NOT filter with null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createNotFilter
methods.description: Tests creation of a NOT filter and checks its type and contained filters.

methods.name: toStringOfNotFilterReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks the string representation of a NOT filter.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullFirstFilter
methods.description: Ensures exception when creating AND filter with null as first argument.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullSecondFilter
methods.description: Ensures exception when creating AND filter with null as second argument.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullAdditionalFilters
methods.description: Ensures exception when creating AND filter with null among additional filters.

methods.name: createAndFilter
methods.description: Creates an AND filter with multiple filters and verifies type and contained filters.

methods.name: toStringOfAndFilterReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the string representation of an AND filter.

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullFirstFilter
methods.description: Ensures exception when creating OR filter with null as first argument.

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullSecondFilter
methods.description: Ensures exception when creating OR filter with null as second argument.

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullAdditionalFilters
methods.description: Ensures exception when creating OR filter with null among additional filters.

methods.name: createOrFilter
methods.description: Creates an OR filter with multiple filters and verifies type and contained filters.

methods.name: toStringOfOrFilterReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the string representation of an OR filter.
